initialize_PyTorchDistBackend: initialize a PyTorchDistBackend with bootstrap_info and commsParams to set up distributed process groups
run_all_reduce: run an all_reduce collective operation on a tensor across all ranks with optional quantization
run_all_to_all: run an all_to_all collective operation to exchange tensor chunks between all ranks in the group
run_all_gather: run an all_gather collective to collect tensors from all ranks into a list on every rank
run_reduce_scatter: run a reduce_scatter collective to reduce and scatter tensor chunks across all ranks
